none: PAS CAM-615CAD: Roman Coin : copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend - no legend. Reverse shows Wolf and twins. Mint is uncertain, AD 330-337. Obverse legend reads [VRBS ROMA]. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left. Reverse fields and exergue is illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.92g, diameter is 16.8mm, thickness is 1.8mm
